hook.name: PmavHookQuotedSlimX
hook.description: A bonding-curve token launchpad hook for pmav.fun V2 (ERC20-quoted). Each pool represents a newly launched coin trading against a fixed quote ERC20 (e.g. USDG). Enforces a block+1 anti-snipe delay, 1% trading fee split 70/30 creator/platform, a permanent 2% wallet cap with automatic refund, and auto-graduates the pool to a full-range position when the raise target is reached.
